Core share math: amount*part/total using SafeMath mul/div.
Core swap output math x*X*Y/(x+X)^2 using SafeMath and raw multiplication.
Core swap fee math x*x*Y/(x+X)^2 using SafeMath.
Core staking-unit math using SafeMath plus a raw 4*(T*B) multiplication for the denominator.
Core asymmetric-share math using SafeMath sub/add/mul/div over U and u powers.
onlyDeployer modifier: require(msg.sender == DEPLOYER) access-control gate on privileged functions.
Timestamp dependency: getPoolAge branches and divides based on block.timestamp ('now').
Arithmetic hazard: raw multiplication 4 * (T.mul(B)) in calcStakeUnits is not overflow-checked by SafeMath.
Arithmetic hazard: part2.sub(part3) can revert/underflow when 2*U*u exceeds U^2 in calcAsymmetricShare.
Arithmetic hazard: denominator (x+X)^2 can be zero leading to division revert in calcSwapOutput.

edges.reason: constructor assigns DEPLOYER from msg.sender, making the deployer identity caller-controlled.
onlyDeployer compares msg.sender against DEPLOYER to gate privileged calls.
setGenesisDao is protected by the onlyDeployer access-control modifier.
getTokenDetails forwards msg.sender as the member of interest.
getTokenDetailsWithMember reads msg.sender.balance for the ETH branch.
block.timestamp ('now') flows into the timestamp-dependent age computation.
getPoolAge branches and divides on block.timestamp, making its result miner-influenced.
setGenesisDao writes the dao argument into the DAO state variable.
getGlobalDetails resolves the router through DAO.ROUTER().
getPool resolves the pool through DAO.ROUTER().getPool(token).
getTokenDetails delegates to getTokenDetailsWithMember.
getPoolData first resolves the pool via getPool.

getPoolROI resolves the pool via getPool.
getPoolAPY consumes the ROI returned by getPoolROI.
getPoolAPY consumes the pool age returned by getPoolAge.
calcPart normalizes basis points and delegates the division to calcShare.
getPoolShare computes base and token amounts through calcShare.
getShareOfBaseAmount computes the share through calcShare.
getShareOfTokenAmount computes the share through calcShare.
calcTokenPPinBaseWithPool delegates to calcSwapOutput.
calcBasePPinTokenWithPool delegates to calcSwapOutput.
calcAsymmetricShare performs part2.sub(part3), a subtraction that can underflow.
calcStakeUnits performs an unchecked raw multiplication 4*(T.mul(B)).
calcSwapOutput divides by (x+X)^2 which can be zero.
tokensInRange resolves each token through getPool/router calls.
poolsInRange resolves each pool address via getPool.
isMember resolves the pool via getPool.
allTokens delegates to tokensInRange over the full token count.
allPools delegates to poolsInRange over the full token count.
calcValueInBase delegates to calcValueInBaseWithPool after resolving the pool.
calcBasePPinToken delegates to calcValueInBaseWithPool.
calcValueInToken delegates to calcValueInTokenWithPool.
calcTokenPPinBase delegates to calcTokenPPinBaseWithPool.
calcValueInBase resolves the pool via getPool.
calcValueInToken resolves the pool via getPool.
calcTokenPPinBase resolves the pool via getPool.
calcBasePPinToken resolves the pool via getPool.
